name: citable-failure
title: The loop first step cites into its third: a citable ref on a mined failure, and a manifest that resolves it
description: The failure reading produces records a manifest cannot cite, and the manifest never resolves the ref it is given - so mining and prediction do not connect. Give the record the ref the resolver already matches, and make the manifest refuse a failure evidence ref that resolves to nothing, with the same rule the pass path uses
creator: aixi
